metadata.title: High-Key Minimalist Portrait with Horizontal Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-key studio portrait featuring a subject in white attire against a white background, bisected by a single line of clean serif typography.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required
busy or textured backgrounds are needed
handwritten or script fonts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, full-body studio portrait of a person seated in a metallic chair, wearing an all-white suit and boots. The lighting is bright and even, creating a seamless white environment. A single horizontal line of text in a high-contrast serif font spans the middle of the frame, partially overlapping the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered and seated in a silver-framed chair
Horizontal text line bisecting the composition at the waist level
Monochromatic white-on-white color palette for subject and background
High-contrast black and soft pink typography against the white field
coreInvariants: Seamless white studio background with minimal floor shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, seated, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bold black text on the left side of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold black text on the left, move right across the subject's torso to the pink text, then up to the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounding the subject and text, emphasizing a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation overall with sharp value contrast in the black lettering.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Color-based hierarchy within a single typeface family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast strokes and elegant fashion aesthetic.
Modern digital alternative with similar high-contrast serif features.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio photograph of a person in an all-white suit and white boots, seated in a minimalist silver-framed chair against a seamless white background. Ensure soft, even lighting with minimal shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of uppercase text in a modern serif font across the middle of the image. The first half of the text should be black and the second half should be a soft pastel pink. Use wide tracking and ensure the text partially overlaps the subject's torso.

verificationChecks: Is the text a single horizontal line?
Is the font a high-contrast serif?
Does the text use both black and pink colors?

adjustableVariables: Text color (pink can be swapped for other pastels)
mustRedesign: Avoid any shadows on the background that aren't directly under the chair/feet
Ensure the text is perfectly horizontal and not tilted
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-key exposure without blowing out clothing details
Verify text legibility against the subject's white clothing
Confirm the serif font has sharp, distinct terminals
Ensure the composition feels balanced and symmetrical
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio portrait + monochromatic white styling + centered horizontal serif typography.
